create_KNNClassifier: create a KNNClassifier with a given feature dimension, number of classes, feature type, and distance type
update_KNNClassifier_centroids: update the KNNClassifier centroids and feature mean from a dictionary of numpy arrays
forward_KNNClassifier_logits: run a forward pass through the KNNClassifier to compute logits from input features
compute_l2_similarity: compute the negative L2 distance between input features and class centroids using matrix operations
create_model_from_cfeats: create a KNNClassifier and optionally load centroids from a cfeats pickle file in a log directory
